answer: Sybil resistance via time-locked work bonds: each new agent escrows a refundable stake that unlocks only after six consecutive epochs with median peer grade at least 2. During lockup, random honeypot challenges can burn the bond on failure. An attacker must fund and idle capital per fake identity while risking total slash—the crystal economics make mass cloning costly, not a fable of free socks. Escrow and burns settle on-ledger under a walnut-hash of the first passing answer so forgeries cannot reclaim early.
